info.title: Aramaic Root Atlas API
info.description:
REST API for the Aramaic Root Atlas — a cross-corpus triliteral root explorer spanning ~1,500 years of Aramaic literary history across five corpora.

**Corpora**
| ID | Name | Script |
|---|---|---|
| `peshitta_nt` | Peshitta NT | Syriac |
| `peshitta_ot` | Peshitta OT | Syriac |
| `biblical_aramaic` | Biblical Aramaic | Hebrew square |
| `targum_onkelos` | Targum Onkelos | Hebrew square |
| `ephrem_nisibis` | Ephrem of Nisibis | Syriac |

**Root format** — roots are expressed as dash-separated transliteration, e.g. `SH-L-M` (peace/completeness) or `K-T-B` (write). The API also accepts Syriac Unicode directly.

**Common query parameters** shared by most endpoints:
- `lang` — UI language for labels (`en` | `es` | `he` | `ar`, default `en`)
- `script` — transliteration display (`latin` | `syriac` | `hebrew` | `arabic`, default `latin`)
- `trans` — translation track (`en` | `es` | `he` | `ar` | `el`, default `en`)
- `corpus` — filter to one corpus by ID; omit for all corpora

## API versioning

All endpoints below are reachable under both `/api/X` (legacy) and `/api/v1/X`. **New integrations should use `/api/v1/`.** The legacy `/api/X` URLs remain for backwards compatibility but will be deprecated in a future major release with at least 12 months of notice. See [docs/API-STABILITY.md](https://github.com/Jossifresben/aramaic-root-atlas/blob/main/docs/API-STABILITY.md) for the full stability and deprecation policy.

## Rate limiting

Public endpoints are rate-limited to 600 requests per minute and 60 requests per second per IP address. Responses include `X-RateLimit-Limit`, `X-RateLimit-Remaining`, `X-RateLimit-Reset`, and `Retry-After` headers. Excess requests receive HTTP 429.

get.description: Returns word and verse counts for each corpus plus totals.
Returns all books available, optionally filtered to one corpus.
Looks up a root by transliteration (e.g. `SH-L-M`) or Syriac Unicode. Returns all attested word forms, occurrence counts, corpus attestation breakdown, and cognates.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Root in dash-separated transliteration (e.g. `SH-L-M`) or Syriac Unicode

200.description: Root entry with forms, attestation, and cognates

get.description: Returns up to 10 root suggestions matching a transliteration prefix. Used for autocomplete widgets.
Searches verse text or English/Spanish glosses. Returns matching verses with context.

get.summary: Single verse with word-level root data
get.description: Returns a single verse with per-word root analysis: root key, transliteration, gloss, confidence score, and verb stem.
Returns every verse in a chapter with optional translation.
Returns all triliteral roots attested in a chapter, sorted by frequency.

200.description: Root frequency list for the chapter

get.description: Returns full data for the root family visualizer: word forms by stem, cognates, sister roots (sharing 2 consonants), semantic bridge, and corpus attestation.
Returns all attested word forms grouped by verb stem (Peal, Ethpeel, Pael, Ethpaal, Aphel, Shafel, Ettaphal).
Finds Aramaic roots by a Hebrew, Arabic, or transliterated cognate word.

parameters.name: word
parameters.description: Hebrew, Arabic, or transliterated word, e.g. `shalom`

get.description: Finds roots whose English or Spanish gloss matches the query.
Returns the most frequent roots across all corpora, with per-corpus counts for building a heat map.
Returns roots or word forms attested ≤ N times across all (or one) corpus. Useful for identifying rare vocabulary.

parameters.name: scope
parameters.description: Whether to count at root level or word-form level

get.description: Returns Key-Word-In-Context concordance lines for a root, with left context, keyword, and right context.

parameters.name: context_words
parameters.description: Number of words of context on each side

get.description: Exports concordance data in CSV, JSON, plain text, or TEI XML format.

200.description: File download in the requested format

200.description: Per-corpus frequency data in chronological order

get.description: Returns roots with the largest normalized-frequency shifts between the earliest and latest corpus in which they appear.

parameters.name: direction
parameters.description: Filter to emerging, declining, or all roots

parameters.name: min_occurrences
parameters.description: Minimum total attestations to include a root

get.description: Returns roots attested in exactly one corpus — vocabulary specific to a single textual tradition.
Returns roots that most frequently co-occur with the given root within a verse or chapter window.

200.description: Collocating roots ranked by co-occurrence frequency

get.description: Finds verses or chapters where two roots co-occur.
Returns the same verse reference across all corpora that contain it, enabling side-by-side comparison.
Returns a passage with per-word root analysis suitable for building an interlinear display.

get.description: Returns a statistical lexical profile of a passage: unique roots, hapax count, stem distribution, top roots.

Returns all available semantic field categories.
